source_title: Rohit Sharma To Return For Mumbai In Vijay Hazare Trophy 2026-27: Report
source_excerpt:
Rohit Sharma is expected to feature for Mumbai in the upcoming Vijay Hazare Trophy, with the former India captain reportedly informing the Mumbai Cricket Association (MCA) about his availability for the domestic one-day tournament.
According to a report by The Indian Express, Rohit has conveyed his decision directly to the state association. However, the number of matches he intends to play remains unclear, with the veteran opener expected to confirm his availability at a later stage.
His participation is likely to begin after India's three-match ODI series against Sri Lanka, scheduled from December 13 to 19. With the international assignment overlapping with the initial phase of the Vijay Hazare Trophy, Rohit's involvement in Mumbai's campaign could be limited.
An MCA source told The Indian Express: "He has informed us that he will be playing for Mumbai in the Vijay Hazare Trophy and to consider him available after India's three-ODI series against Sri Lanka at home. How many matches he will be available for, he will inform us later."

Rohit's reported decision would mark another domestic appearance for Mumbai after he returned to the Vijay Hazare Trophy last season. It was his first participation in the competition since 2018, following the BCCI's emphasis on centrally contracted and national-team players turning out for their respective state sides when not occupied with international commitments.
The opener made an impressive start to his previous campaign, smashing 155 runs off just 94 deliveries against Sikkim. However, he could not maintain that momentum in the following fixture, getting dismissed for a duck against Uttarakhand.

The league stage of the upcoming Vijay Hazare Trophy is scheduled to run from December 14 to 29, while the knockout matches will take place between January 2 and 8.
India's ODI series against Sri Lanka is scheduled from December 13 to 19, with matches set to be played in Delhi, Bengaluru and Ahmedabad. The overlapping schedule could influence how many Vijay Hazare Trophy games Rohit is able to play.
Meanwhile, speculation continues over Rohit's role at Mumbai Indians ahead of IPL 2027, with reports suggesting that the franchise could consider restoring him as captain. However, no official announcement has confirmed a change in leadership.

## रिपोर्ट: रोहित शर्मा मुंबई टीम के लिए उपलब्ध रहेंगे

भारतीय क्रिकेट टीम के पूर्व कप्तान रोहित शर्मा के आगामी विजय हजारे ट्रॉफी घरेलू एकदिवसीय टूर्नामेंट में मुंबई की ओर से खेलने की संभावना है। एक मीडिया रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, उन्होंने मुंबई क्रिकेट एसोसिएशन (MCA) को अपनी उपलब्धता के बारे में सूचित कर दिया है। 

## अंतरराष्ट्रीय सीरीज और शेड्यूल का प्रभाव

रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, रोहित शर्मा की भागीदारी भारत और श्रीलंका के बीच होने वाली तीन मैचों की वनडे सीरीज के बाद शुरू होने की उम्मीद है। यह सीरीज 13 से 19 दिसंबर के बीच तय की गई है, जो विजय हजारे ट्रॉफी के शुरुआती चरण के साथ ओवरलैप हो सकती है।

- **लीग चरण:** 14 से 29 दिसंबर के बीच आयोजित होने की योजना है।
- **नॉकआउट मैच:** 2 जनवरी से 8 जनवरी के बीच खेले जाएंगे।
- **अज्ञात बिंदु:** रोहित कितने मैचों में खेलेंगे, इस पर स्थिति अभी स्पष्ट नहीं है और वह बाद में अपनी उपलब्धता की पुष्टि करेंगे।

## घरेलू क्रिकेट और बीसीसीआई की नीति

यह कदम बीसीसीआई के उस जोर के अनुरूप है जिसके तहत केंद्रीय अनुबंधित और राष्ट्रीय खिलाड़ियों को अंतरराष्ट्रीय व्यस्तता न होने पर अपने राज्यीय दलों के लिए खेलने के लिए कहा जाता है। पिछले सीजन में भी उन्होंने 2018 के बाद इस प्रतियोगिता में वापसी की थी।

## कैसे करें पुष्टि

इस मामले की आधिकारिक पुष्टि के लिए मुंबई क्रिकेट एसोसिएशन (MCA) या बीसीसीआई की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट और विज्ञप्तियों का अवलोकन किया जा सकता है।

en_body:
## Domestic Return Expected After Sri Lanka Series

According to reports from *The Indian Express*, former India captain Rohit Sharma is expected to feature for Mumbai in the upcoming Vijay Hazare Trophy 2026-27 domestic one-day tournament. An unnamed Mumbai Cricket Association (MCA) source stated that Rohit has communicated his availability directly to the state association.

However, several details regarding his participation remain unconfirmed:
* **Match Availability:** The exact number of matches Rohit intends to play is currently unclear, with the player reportedly planning to confirm his specific availability at a later date.
* **Schedule Overlap:** India's upcoming three-match ODI series against Sri Lanka is scheduled from December 13 to 19, overlapping with the initial phase of the Vijay Hazare Trophy, which runs its league stage from December 14 to 29.
* **Timeline:** Because of the international assignment, Rohit's involvement in Mumbai's campaign is likely to begin only after the conclusion of the Sri Lanka series.

## Context and Background

This reported decision follows the Board of Control for Cricket in India's (BCCI) policy urging centrally contracted and national-team players to represent their respective state sides when not on international duty. Last season marked Rohit's return to the Vijay Hazare Trophy—his first appearance in the competition since 2018—highlighted by a 155-run innings off 94 balls against Sikkim, followed by a duck against Uttarakhand.

The knockout matches for the tournament are scheduled between January 2 and 8. Meanwhile, independent media reports have also sparked speculation regarding Rohit's potential return to the captaincy for the Mumbai Indians ahead of the Indian Premier League (IPL) 2027, though no official franchise announcement has confirmed any leadership changes.

## How to Verify

Readers seeking verified updates can check official announcements directly through:
* The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) official communications.
* The Mumbai Cricket Association (MCA) press releases regarding squad selections.
* Official fixtures and squad lists published ahead of the Vijay Hazare Trophy league stage.
